items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He had been playing with Herbie Fields, with Rosolino, I think.

ctx.x: I know him because of the L.A. Express, but obviously he had a career at least a couple decades long before that. He seemed to have been a major fixture, a cornerstone of the L.A. scene.
Not then. He was an Easterner then. He had been playing with Herbie Fields, with Rosolino, I think.
Yeah, because he‟s in the band.
